items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because see, Bing used to be with Paul Whiteman, who...

ctx.x: Yeah. I don't know whether it was a pit band or what. But he went on before we did. Because we were the stars. We went on before he did. And Bing, he didn't have no stage presence at all. But he could sing. He'd just walk... He'd walk out on the stage and do it. Because see, Bing used to be with Paul Whiteman, who...
Oh, he had left Paul Whiteman then??
